Metadata.title: WorkSphere — Enterprise Project & Work Management
Metadata.description: A Jira + Trello style Multi-tenant SaaS collaboration platform

Home.tagline: Run every team, project, and workflow in one clear workspace
Home.subtitle: Combine Jira-grade task tracking and dependency graphs with the speed of Trello Kanban boards — backed by custom multi-tenant isolation and 4-tier RBAC.
Home.sectionTitle: Production-grade architecture from the ground up
Home.sectionSubtitle: Engineered for multi-organization teams with strict server-side authorization and concurrency safety.

issues.title: Jira-style Tasks & Dependencies
issues.body: Structured tasks, subtasks, atomic project keys (e.g. ENG-104), and automated dependency cycle detection.

board.title: Trello-style Kanban Boards
board.body: Smooth drag-and-drop columns powered by fractional indexing and instant real-time team synchronization.

rbac.title: Custom Multi-tenant RBAC
rbac.body: Isolated organizations and workspaces protected by 4-tier server-side permission guards.

showcase.heading: A clean, secure workspace built for high-velocity teams
showcase.description: Create organizations, organize department workspaces, assign tasks, and collaborate in real time.
showcase.point1: Strict cross-tenant isolation with automatic refresh token rotation
showcase.point2: Precision-ordered Kanban boards with optimistic locking
showcase.point3: Directed acyclic task dependencies with cycle prevention
